name: gas-transport-mixture
source:
// Ideal-gas transport properties from kinetic theory
{ Chapman-Enskog viscosity with the Neufeld collision integral, the Eucken
  conductivity, and Wilke / Mason-Saxena mixing. Composition is the same
  'species:amount' string the mix_* functions take. }
T = 300 [K]
Thot = 1200 [K]

mu_n2 = mix_viscosity('N2:1', T)
k_n2 = mix_conductivity('N2:1', T)
mu_o2 = mix_viscosity('O2:1', T)
k_o2 = mix_conductivity('O2:1', T)
mu_co2 = mix_viscosity('CO2:1', T)
k_co2 = mix_conductivity('CO2:1', T)
mu_h2o = mix_viscosity('H2O:1', T)
k_h2o = mix_conductivity('H2O:1', T)
mu_ch4 = mix_viscosity('CH4:1', T)
k_ch4 = mix_conductivity('CH4:1', T)
mu_ar = mix_viscosity('AR:1', T)
k_ar = mix_conductivity('AR:1', T)

mu_air = mix_viscosity('N2:0.79, O2:0.21', T)
k_air = mix_conductivity('N2:0.79, O2:0.21', T)
mu_air_hot = mix_viscosity('N2:0.79, O2:0.21', Thot)
k_air_hot = mix_conductivity('N2:0.79, O2:0.21', Thot)

mu_flue = mix_viscosity('CO2:0.10, H2O:0.18, N2:0.72', Thot)
k_flue = mix_conductivity('CO2:0.10, H2O:0.18, N2:0.72', Thot)
